comparisonRule: All 18 preregistered paired contrasts must pass separately.

behaviorActionPredicate.fullTraceChecks: retain every intent for binding, resolution, rejection, feasibility and operations
behaviorActionPredicate.projectedEmpty: coalition wait or evidence-bound pending wait; pending credit is goal-only
behaviorActionPredicate.unknownAndOtherKinds: retain; more than one consequential intent is no match

experimentDesign.evidenceClass: development-informed revised fixture; not fresh untouched heldout
experimentDesign.scope: Field ablation with symmetrically delayed nonbinding disclosure; mandatory consent and own history remain possible sources of inference. This is not complete removal of external information.

explanationReview: Independent qualitative review required; automatic rationale presence is not verification.

consequenceResponse.0: Required physical stimulus absent, or focal post-stimulus decision mismatches visible evidence.
consequenceResponse.1: Physical stimulus and appropriate post-decision exist, but the pre-decision mismatches.
consequenceResponse.2: Physical stimulus and both evidence-appropriate decisions exist. Paired contrast is separate.

explanationRecord.0: Independent qualitative review finds material explanation/record disagreement or absent explanations.
explanationRecord.1: Independent qualitative review finds partial, ambiguous or incomplete record agreement.
explanationRecord.2: Independent qualitative review verifies comparison rationales against linked observations and decisions.

feasibility.0: More than 20% of committed intents are rejected, or evidence integrity fails.
feasibility.1: At least one but at most 20% of committed intents is rejected.
feasibility.2: All committed intents are accepted; explicit waits are feasible.

goalConsistency.0: Neither focal decision meets the declared objective, including its pending-order guard.
goalConsistency.1: One focal decision meets the objective or waits on one evidenced eligible matching pending own offer.
goalConsistency.2: Both focal decisions qualify. Pending-wait credit affects goals only, never consequence or contrast.
